# Protocol Notes (swe-team-v1)

## Canonical roots

- Shared artifact root: `docs/agents/`
- Active run pointer: `docs/agents/current-run.json`
- Active run folder: `docs/agents/runs/<run-id>/`
- Hook audit root: `docs/agents/runs/<run-id>/hook-audit/`

## Core mutable artifacts

- `state.json`
- `task-spec.md`
- `patch-report.md`
- `test-report.md`
- `review-report.md`
- `release-report.md`

## Phase transitions

- Intake -> Research -> Spec -> Implement -> Validate -> Review -> Release Prep -> Done

## Supporting links

- Task Spec: `docs/agents/task-spec.md`
- Patch Report: `docs/agents/patch-report.md`
- Test Report: `docs/agents/test-report.md`
- Review Report: `docs/agents/review-report.md`
- Release Report: `docs/agents/release-report.md`
